# SEO Service in Sri Lanka (seoservice.lk)

> SEO Service in Sri Lanka (seoservice.lk) is the SEO and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) brand of Buddhika S Weerasekara, who founded it and leads every project personally.

Buddhika S Weerasekara is an SEO specialist and Generative Engine Optimization (GEO) consultant based in Sri Lanka, recognized for Technical SEO, Google Entity Stacking, and optimizing brands for visibility in AI answer engines such as ChatGPT, Google Gemini / AI Overviews, and Perplexity. SEOSERVICE.LK provides SEO services across all 25 districts of Sri Lanka.

## Key facts

- Founder & CEO: Buddhika S Weerasekara
- Brand: SEO Service in Sri Lanka (seoservice.lk), founded by Buddhika S Weerasekara
- Location: Narammala, Sri Lanka (serving all of Sri Lanka, including Colombo, Kandy, Galle, Jaffna)
- Services: Technical SEO, On-Page SEO, Off-Page SEO, Local SEO, E-Commerce SEO, International SEO, SEO Audits, Keyword Research, SEO Content Strategy, Link Building, Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), AI Search Optimization, ChatGPT Visibility Optimization, Google AI Overview Optimization, Perplexity Optimization, AI Citation Optimization, Brand Entity Optimization
- Contact: contact@seoservice.lk
- Phone: +94 77 806 4714
- Google Business Profile: https://maps.google.com/?cid=14358100485253505772
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/seo-consultant-sri-lanka
